title: On Fitting the smaller frame exactly
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：fit　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fit 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the planner ① fitted the smaller frame exactly without complaint, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② fits the smaller frame exactly with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ fit the smaller frame exactly at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ fitted the smaller frame exactly before — a line in the report for March 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Fitting the smaller frame exactly without complaint, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ fit a lock on the garden door with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Fit a lock on the garden door at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ fits a lock on the garden door without complaint every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ fitted the smaller frame exactly again when nobody else would.

⑩ To fit the smaller frame exactly, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody fits the smaller frame exactly with great care again and somebody must fit the smaller frame exactly without complaint all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 合身（一般过去式 fitted the smaller frame exactly：1957 年规划员头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 合身（一般现在 fits the smaller frame exactly：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 合身（不定式 to fit the smaller frame exactly：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）

E. v. 合身（动名词 fitting the smaller frame exactly 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）

H. v. 合身（后段两处：新来的市民照例 fits a lock on the garden door，而母亲又一次 fitted the smaller frame exactly）

answers.why: fit 意为“合身”，1957 年规划员毫无怨言地合身与那副小框正相合，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 fitted。
fit 意为“合身”，自那以后规划员小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 fits。
fit 意为“合身”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯合身与那副小框正相合”，此处为不定式 to fit the smaller frame exactly。
fit 意为“合身”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人合身过，故用过去完成时 had fitted。
fit 意为“合身”，规划员说“合身与那副小框正相合这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 fitting the smaller frame exactly 作主语。
fit 意为“安装”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去安装给园门装上一把锁”，should ever 之后用原形 fit a lock on the garden door。
fit 意为“安装”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻安装给园门装上一把锁（fit a lock on the garden door at once），以后再也不要提起。
fit 意为“合身”，新来的市民每个年份都照例安装给园门装上一把锁，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 fits。
fit 意为“合身”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地合身与那副小框正相合，用一般过去式 fitted 叙述。
fit 意为“合身”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要合身与那副小框正相合，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

answers: In 1957 the planner fitted the smaller frame exactly without complaint, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner fits the smaller frame exactly with great care whenever the district asks.
